title: docs(adr-0066): D4's 2026-10-29 amendment still says api actions on sys_* objects stay off MCP; close it with a dated note once #27940 lands
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Follow-up of #27681 (maintainer ruling B, record `6513869839`). The mechanism PR #27940 lets an action on a `sys_*` object be listed and run over MCP when the action itself declares `ai.exposed: true`. It does not edit ADR-0066, and the ruling lets the ADR note follow separately. Filed by the `domain:server#2` seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ADR says today (`origin/main`)

`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`, D4, the 2026-10-29 amendment paragraph: "`list_actions` and `run_action` keep the `ai.exposed` opt-in and the fail-closed `sys_*` guard (… both through `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts#isSystemObjectName`), so `sys_user.ban_user` and the other api actions on platform `sys_*` objects stay off MCP and reach an agent through REST … — a gap this amendment records and does not close; card #27681 carries it."

Once #27940 merges, that sentence describes a guard that no longer exists in that form, and it names a card that is closed.

## Wanted

A dated closing note under that amendment, in the ADR's own amendment style (Prime Directive #13: a recorded decision changes by an ADR edit). It should say:

- the gap is closed by #27940, under ruling `6513869839`;
- the rule is now per action: only an action that declares `ai.exposed: true` itself is listed and run over MCP. The stored-metadata body family (`sys_metadata`, `sys_metadata_history`) stays refused before the flag is read;
- every gate after admission is unchanged.

Name the symbols as they are at the merge commit, not as this card quotes them. Out of scope: the action-invocation audit row (#27908) and the platform `ai` declarations (#27900).

Do this only after #27940 has merged. Until then the current sentence is still true.

Links: #27681, #27940, ruling `6513869839`, #27506 (the amendment's own ruling).

Filed without `domain:*`. Grading is triage's.
